text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing training with Sweep Tosho,
just as I was about to start tidying up..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, familiar, are you trying to wrap this up already? You don't understand your master at all, do you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When we started training,
you saw me using magic, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I cast my 'Cheer-Up Magic' on a classmate today, and she was so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Lemme try using
the same magic on myself!
Dimor-dimor photheca—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I've got the 'Magic of Energy' on my side!
I can still keep running!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho was uncharacteristically enthusiastic about training. While I'm glad she's channeling her surplus energy into running, still...
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do some extra running!
Let's put that energy toward something other than running!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's the spirit♪
I can tackle any workout on the menu today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's it! I'll cast my 'Energy Magic'
on you too! Special service just for you♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Dimorph-dimorphothecaâ
Inner vitality, well up within me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now you should be full of energy!
Come on, run with me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magic is absolute perfection!
Hurry up or I'll leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In high spirits from start to finish,
Sweep Tosho gave her all during training.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, other than running?
choice_data_list: Like developing a new spell or something

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, not bad for a familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
To create new magic...
we just have to draw all kinds of magic circles and test them out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided,
I'm going to run the experiment right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing? Hurry up and follow me!
As my familiar, of course you have to help out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Afterwards, I ended up drawing magic circles
until sundown, but at least we managed
to prevent any overworking.
